name: Qwen3.6 evaluation — should we upgrade from Qwen3.5-35B MXFP4?

description: Baseline: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B via vllm-qwen35-mxfp4:cu130 runtime MXFP4, thinking=false, 10 reqs + 3 warmup, max_tokens=256

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B BF16 base + runtime MXFP4 via vllm-qwen35-mxfp4:cu130 (CUTLASS_FP4 kernels, SM120/Blackwell native). -1.1% tok/s vs 3.5 baseline — within 10-req noise floor. TTFT p95 regressed 58%. Kept in models.yaml for now; try FP8/NVFP4 before final decision.

Qwen3.6-FP8 via vllm-qwen35-mxfp4:cu130 — tok/s 48.2, 14.4% below 56.3 baseline. vLLM auto-selected TRITON FP8 MoE backend (slow on Blackwell). Available-but-unused faster backends for this hardware: DEEPGEMM, FLASHINFER_TRTLLM, FLASHINFER_CUTLASS. Would need a vllm-deepgemm image + explicit VLLM_FP8_MOE_BACKEND env or similar to force Blackwell-native kernel. Out of scope for this round; revert and try NVFP4 first. Also fixed a supervisor zombie-process bug mid-run that had been spamming fake 'readonly database' errors.

Did not bench — pre-flight check found NVFP4 is infeasible on GB10 today. mmangkad model targets SGLang not vLLM. GB10 (sm_121) lacks the cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32 PTX instruction NVFP4 needs; FlashInfer/CUTLASS NVFP4 paths all crash. Avarok's community workaround (software E2M1 emulation) reports ~35 tok/s, already below iter-1's 55.7. Revisit when vLLM ships native sm_121 NVFP4 kernels (issue #31085).

rationale: Tie with Qwen3.5 baseline (56.3 → 55.7 tok/s, -1.1%, within noise). Newer model, zero migration cost (same alias, image, extra_args). FP8 is -14.4% regression due to Triton kernel fallback. NVFP4 infeasible on GB10. MXFP4 is the viable path.

description: Tried upgrading vLLM to gain instanttensor + max_num_batched_tokens=8192. Both upstream images failed during weight load with MARLIN MoE backend errors on GB10 sm_121 (vLLM 0.19.2rc1: 'tensor a (1024) vs b (2048)'; vLLM 0.17.1rc1: 'tuple index out of range' on loaded_weight.shape[2]). Root cause: upstream vLLM MARLIN MoE kernel cannot handle Qwen3.5/3.6 GatedDeltaNet/MoE expert weights on sm_121 — shared memory race condition + no specialized GDN kernel. Tracked in vllm-project/vllm#30135, #35924, #37030. The only working path is custom namake-taro patches (https://github.com/namake-taro/vllm-custom) baked into our current vllm-qwen35-mxfp4:cu130 image. CUTLASS_FP4 + online MXFP4 quant only works with those patches. No viable upgrade until either: (a) namake-taro releases a newer patched vLLM, or (b) upstream vLLM merges sm_121 MARLIN MoE fix. Reverted models.yaml to iter-1 state.

notes: Our current docker image is the namake-taro-patched vLLM 0.17.0 build — the only MXFP4 MoE path that works on GB10 sm_121. Forum author reports 70 tok/s for Qwen3.5 with these patches, suggesting there's tuning headroom we haven't explored (our 55-56 range may be missing some args). Revisit when either namake-taro ships newer patches or upstream vLLM lands #30135/#37030 fixes for sm_121 MARLIN.
